Name: alab_scorpio_switch
Description: Astera Labs Scorpio PCIe switch telemetry on the Nsight Systems timeline - per-port bandwidth, PCIe link error counters and die temperature. Correlate switch traffic with GPU workload and analyze how link errors affect it.
SetupNotes: This plugin is part of Astera Labs COSMOS software suite, please contact Astera Labs support for installation and usage instructions.
